title: Card 5: data code se baanto (ring). Code ki machine + agli 2 pe copy

callouts.red: Country se baant dete, ya ek badi machine le lete?
callouts.green: Country se: code dekh ke pata nahi chalta kis machine pe, saari poochni padti. Ek machine: 90 TB usme aata hi nahi

callouts.red: Seedha code % machine ginti se baant dete?
callouts.green: Ek machine judi to (3 se 4) lagbhag saare link ki jagah badal jaati. Ring me sirf pados wale link hilte
Har link ki 3 copy hain (apni machine + agli 2). Baaki 2 copy se mil jaata, Arpan ka link nahi gaya

callouts.red: Ek machine pe zyada bojh aa gaya
callouts.green: Har machine ring pe 100-200 jagah baithti (virtual nodes), to bojh barabar bat jaata

callouts.red: Data sirf ~500 GB hota to? Ek MySQL kaafi. Tukde tabhi jab ek machine me na aaye.
callouts.green: Cassandra kyun? Join ya transaction chahiye hi nahi, bas code se link, aur data 90 TB

callouts.red: Cassandra me primary copy kaunsi? Koi nahi, teeno barabar, koi bhi likh / padh sakti.
callouts.green: Copy badhane se likhna tez? Nahi, har copy pe likhna padta. Likhne ka bojh tukde (shard) se ghatta

kyun: Har click code ke saath aata, aur code se tay hota ki wo kis machine pe hai (ring). To har click seedha ek machine pe jaata, saari machine nahi poochni padti
ab: DB team boli: 5 saal me 90 TB, ek machine me nahi aata
agla: ab har tukde ki 3 copy hain. Par Arpan ka naya link kholte hi 404? (card 6)
